in_sanskrit.name: Sidhant
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: the one who has reached the goal, the one who has accomplished, the one who has achieved the end point

in_hindi.name: सिधान्त
in_hindi.long_meaning: सिधान्त - सामग्रीसे सापेक्ष मात्रम, माध्यम, प्रकार, पुरुष के लिए प्राप्त होना, समुदाय से अपना वजन होना, सफलता प्राप्त करना, कोषित्र पूरा करना, अथवा प्रतिपद्धति के साथ समुद्र के तट पहुंचना

in_tamil.name: Arulmigu
in_tamil.long_meaning: the one who is blessed by God, the one who is under God's protection, the one who is graced by the divine

in_telugu.name: Siddharama
in_telugu.meaning: one who has achieved their goal
in_telugu.long_meaning: the one who has accomplished his task, the one who has reached the pinnacle of success, the one who has achieved mastery over something

in_marathi.name: Sidhant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sidhant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who achieves his goals

in_bengali.name: Sidhant
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sidhant একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who achieves his goals
